subject.title: fix(model-selection): warn on duplicate model aliases instead of silently overwriting [AI-assisted]model-selection: warn on duplicate model aliases instead of silently …

question: Should duplicate model aliases preserve shipped last-match selection while warning, or may this PR intentionally switch existing duplicate aliases to first-match selection?
rationale: The warning itself is straightforward, but changing the selected provider/model for existing config is a compatibility and auth-provider routing decision that should not be inferred from a drive-by PR.

options.title: Preserve shipped winner while warning
options.body: Keep the currently selected last matching provider/model, emit duplicate warnings, and add matching alias-index coverage.

options.title: Approve first-match precedence
options.body: Accept the provider/model reroute only with explicit upgrade proof and tests covering the compatibility break.

options.title: Pause for a unified replacement
options.body: Use one coherent duplicate-alias fix that covers both resolver paths if maintainers do not want to repair this branch.

recommendation.title: Preserve shipped winner while warning
recommendation.body: Keep the currently selected last matching provider/model, emit duplicate warnings, and add matching alias-index coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced model aliases and owns much of the shared model-selection helper history.
